description.value: Bar Corso is a modern Italian bar in Vancouver's Little Italy neighbourhood on Commercial Drive, specializing in cicchetti (small Italian tapas), craft cocktails, grappa, and a curated wine selection. Executive Chef Luke Boswell leads a seasonal, ever-changing menu rooted in classic Italian technique and local ingredients, with intimate winemaker dinners rounding out the experience. Walk-ins are welcome, and the convivial late-night atmosphere makes it a natural evening destination for cyclists exploring the Drive.
